test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who was the first Indian to join the Indian Civil Service?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satyendranath Tagore.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satyendranath Tagore** was the **first Indian **who became an** Indian Civil Service officer in 1864.**
 
• He was an** Indo-Bengali **civil servant, poet, composer, writer, social reformer, and linguist from** Kolkata, West Bengal. **
 
• He was a** member of Brahmo Samaj.**
 
• Some of his literary works include **Bombai Chitr, Nabaratnamala, Bouddhadharma, Bharatbarsiyo Ingrej, etc. **
 
• His patriotic Bengali language song** "Mile Sabe Bharat Santan, Ektan Gago Gaan" **(unite, India's children, sing in unison), is considered as the **first national anthem of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Lakshmi Kant Jha **from Bihar is the** eighth Governor of the Reserve Bank of India** from 1967 to 1970. 
 
• **Hirubhai Patel **was an Indian civil servant who played a major role in the issues regarding internal and national security in the first years after the independence of India. From 1977 to 1979, he served as the** Finance Minister** and later** Home Minister** of India. 
 
• **Shyamji Krishna Varma** is an Indian revolutionary and freedom fighter, lawyer, and journalist who founded the** Indian Home Rule Society**,** India House, and The Indian Sociologist in London. **
